QuestInfo.name: Checking on the Nautilus
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: You must prepare for the Black Mage's imminent return. \r\nMeet Kyrin at the Nautilus to see how things are going there.
QuestInfo.2: You go to meet Kyrin at the Nautilus. She says everything's fine.

0.0: We can't rest easy yet,  #h0#. There is more work to be done.
0.1: The Black Mage's resurrection is imminent. The Explorers of the Maple Alliance need to be ready.
0.2: So I want you to check with #bKyrin#k at the Nautilus and make sure everything's in tip-top shape.

yes.0: Every town must be prepared, but we have so little time...

1.0: Hey, it's been a while. Did Pierce send you?
1.1: You can tell her the Nautilus is ready to set sail at a moment's notice

yes.0: The last time the Black Mage attacked, the folks of Maple World weren't as united. This time, we'll be ready for him.

npc.0: I want you to check with #bKyrin#k at the Nautilus and make sure everything's in tip-top shape.
